prompt: Which line would be most useful in the morning briefing?
promptZh: 早班簡報用哪一行最能幫上忙？

options.text: Ask North to check the goods and compare “Item seen” with the expected code.
options.zh: 請北分店檢查貨品，並用「目視品項」和預期代碼比對。
options.whyZh: 北分店接手容器，貨品在那裡。掃到的只是可重複使用容器上的貼紙；需要看容器內的商品代碼，才能查清型號是否和預期一致。

options.text: Ask North to repeat the scan and compare “Scanned code” with the expected code.
options.zh: 請北分店重新掃描，並用「掃描代碼」和預期代碼比對。
options.whyZh: 北分店是對的地點，但重新掃到的是容器貼紙，而不是裡面的商品。這無法確認當初是否裝了不同型號。

options.text: Ask West to check the goods and compare “Item seen” with the expected code.
options.zh: 請西分店檢查貨品，並用「目視品項」和預期代碼比對。
options.whyZh: 查看裡面的商品代碼正是所需的查核，但西分店收到的是申請。容器由北分店接收，應請那裡的同仁查。

options.text: Ask West to repeat the scan and compare “Scanned code” with the expected code.
options.zh: 請西分店重新掃描，並用「掃描代碼」和預期代碼比對。
options.whyZh: 西分店並未接手容器；就算重新掃描，也只會讀到容器貼紙，不能證明裡面是哪個型號。

explanationZh: 北分店接手容器，貨品在那裡。掃到的只是可重複使用容器上的貼紙；需要看容器內的商品代碼，才能查清型號是否和預期一致。
evidence: “Follow-up branch” shows where the request was sent. / “Handed to,” which records the branch that took the container and now has the goods. / “Scanned code” comes from the sticker on the reusable container. / Staff enter “Item seen” by reading the product code on an item inside / The count is right and the scanner shows the expected code. / “Follow-up branch: West; Handed to: North.” / One of us remembered putting a different model in there

vocabulary.note: reusable 意為可以重複使用；容器上的標籤不一定能代表這次裝入的物品。
